Fourth TU reconstruction pilot (after PoleLift, ShipWater, ArrowSignRight). No forced vtable +2 addend fix was needed here: daObjPathLift_c's own destructor stays a declared-but-never-defined virtual (its D1/D0 bodies reproduce PathLift's own out-of-line cleanup inline, under the mangled D1/D0 names, as free extern "C" functions -- a real out-of-line `daObjPathLift_c::~daObjPathLift_c()` measured 999 differing words, because PathLift's own destructor is genuinely out-of-line rather than inline-on-purpose like dBgActor_c's), so this TU never becomes the key-function TU for its own class and emits no _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS at all -- confirmed by reading every symbol in the compiled object directly (no externalized_output entries needed this time). The one EXTRA symbol is the same class of gap ArrowSignRight hit: _ZN7Vector3D1Ev, a compiler-emitted duplicate of Vector3's own real (and deliberately empty, per include/types.h's own comment) destructor, which has a configured ROM home (arm9 0x020072c0) and so fits neither compiler_only_output (rejected: has a ROM home) nor externalized_output (rejected: not _ZTI/_ZTS, not .data) -- left deliberately unlicensed per the same policy-schema gap documented on the ArrowSignRight pilot.

Reconciliation against real headers, matching the user's standing readability directive: Render()'s `((Obj*)((char*)this+0xd4))->m(0)` shadow-vtable-dispatch hack replaced with `mModel.Render(0)` (mModel is a real dBgActor_c member, inherited through PathLift) -- third repeat of the exact idiom from ShipWater/ArrowSignRight. Behavior() and InitResources() were converted from extern "C" free functions taking `char* c` into real `daObjPathLift_c::Behavior()`/`::InitResources()` methods (Render and CleanupResources already were, in the legacy source): raw casts to dBgActor_c*/PathLift*/dBgW* replaced with direct calls (UpdateClsnPosAndRot(), BaseBehavior(), mMeshCollider.IsEnabled()/.Enable(this)), and the two Model/dBgW_Kc LoadFile calls and ModelBase::SetFile call now go through the real mModel/qualified-static members. mMeshCollider.SetFile(...) deliberately stays extern "C": its real member signature takes a `Fix12<int> scale` parameter with no converting constructor from an int literal, and materialising the call's 0x1000 argument into one costs stack traffic the ROM's own codegen does not have (the same Fix12<int>-aggregate cost already documented on IsClsnInRange in this class's own Behavior()) -- verified 8/8 MATCH before and after every one of these swaps, one at a time.

decl_common.h dropped from this TU (both places it was included): it declares data_ov100_02148a54/data_ov100_02148a5c as plain `int`, less complete than the real SharedFilePtr type this TU's own InitResources/CleanupResources need to call through Model::LoadFile/SharedFilePtr::Release as real members -- same class of conflict as ArrowSignRight's data_ov098_0213c380. The five other symbols/functions decl_common.h would have supplied (data_ov100_0214857c, data_ov002_0210d7d4, func_ov002_020efcf4, func_ov002_020efc74, func_ov100_02146e70) are restated locally at the same type it used, since nothing else in this TU needed a more complete type for them.
